caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a rounded, reddish-brown vessel with a textured surface, mounted on a shallow, circular dish of the same color. The vessel features a lid adorned with a sculpted figure of a bird, likely a rooster, positioned upright with a small beak, comb, and detailed wings and tail. The bird is the same reddish-brown as the vessel, with darker shading for detail and some lighter highlights. The vessel and base both have a stippled pattern with subtle, scattered light blue and white accents. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Pa. German Child's Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
